item.description: Doué injury adds to that of Kvaratskhelia last month Nice 2-3 PSG; Lazio 3-0 Lecce; Gladbach 0-1 Dortmund Désiré Doué was carried off in tears after suffering what looked like a nasty knee injury as Paris Saint-Germain beat Nice 3-2 in Ligue 1. Doué went down after twisting awkwardly late in the first half as he tried to control the ball, shortly after scoring to put PSG 2-1 ahead. He looked to be in agony as he clutched his right knee, and the match was stopped for five minutes to allow Doué to receive treatment before being carried off to a backdrop of applause from the crowd at the Allianz Riviera stadium.
